newsitem.title: USA: American Residential names a CFO.
newsitem.headline: American Residential names a CFO.

text.p: American Residential Services Inc said Friday one of its co-founders, William P. McCaughey, currently serving as executive vice president for planning and development, had been elected by the board to serve as the chief financial officer.
The company also said it has closed the first two acquisitions since its initial public offering was completed in late September.
The two companies acquired are McCannics Inc and Dial One Jeff Kirkhoff Plumbing Company Inc which have combined annual revenue of the two companies is about $5 million.
Terms of the purchase transactions were not disclosed, American Residential said.
It said McCannics President Ron McCann has been appointed to serve as the company's director of market development.

McCannics provides residential air conditioning and heating services primarily in the fastest growing suburban part of the greater Houston metropolitan area, and Kirkhoff Plumbing provides residential plumbing repair, maintenance and replacement services in the Indianapolis metropolitan area. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
